criteria.notes: RETRACTION of my own earlier note: I wrote that '8 Cl_2(pi/4) = 7.3277' without computing it. Recomputed (mpmath clsin, 30 dps): Cl_2(pi/4) = 0.9818721511, so 8*Cl_2(pi/4) = 7.8549772084 -- 7.20 percent ABOVE Vol(Borromean) = 7.3277247534. The correct identity is Vol_Borromean = 8*Cl_2(pi/2) = 8G = 16*Lambda(pi/4). DEFECT (reported, not fixed -- math): row 5 of this table states 'Vol_Borromean | 8 Cl_2(pi/4) carrier', which contradicts (a) its OWN Lean carrier, ClausenFunctionMathlibFiller.lean:139 'noncomputable def Vol_Borromean : Real := 8 * Cl_2 (Real.pi / 2)', proved against 7.3277247534 by CatalanValueBounds.abs_Vol_Borromean_sub_lt, and (b) row 3 of this same table, which correctly gives Catalan_constant = Cl_2(pi/2). Rows Vol_figure_8 = 2 Cl_2(pi/3) (Lean line 130) and Catalan_constant = Cl_2(pi/2) (Lean line 121) both check out; only the pi/4 argument is wrong. This is the AGENTS.md Lambda-vs-Cl_2 argument-swap class.
